preflight.comparisonMethod: Match repository version, full canonical filename stem or timestamp-stripped historical name. For the two established historical split migrations, require every documented remote part.
preflight.countsScope: All takeoff_items joined to takeoff_jobs with job.status <> 'applied', using the prepared task's exact count query; aggregate counts only.

trigger.definition: CREATE TRIGGER exclude_new_takeoff_hypothesis BEFORE INSERT ON public.takeoff_items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION exclude_new_takeoff_hypothesis()

securityAdvisors.comparisonMethod: Compare each finding by advice name, level, detail and metadata; ignore observed_at only.

methods: Supabase connector list_projects: target identity, no API keys requested.
Git fetch origin and GitHub PR read: merged source and exact origin/main blob; source hash matches migration manifest.
Supabase connector list_migrations: before and after, canonical/alias/split comparison.
Supabase connector execute_sql: read-only prerequisite catalogue and prepared before-count query.

Supabase connector get_advisors(type=security): all 95 finding identities unchanged.
retro-guards/tool-results.cjs assertSuccess: 12 project/migration/query/advisor response envelopes validated.

queries.preflight: select clock_timestamp() as observed_at, (select count(*) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) as history_rows, (select max(version) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) as latest_version, (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',table_name,'column',column_name,'type',data_type,'nullable',is_nullable) order by table_name,ordinal_position) from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and ((table_name='takeoff_items' and column_name in ('job_id','is_excluded','metadata','quantity_entry_category','exclusion_reason','unit','source_file_name','source_page')) or (table_name='takeoff_jobs' and column_name in ('id','status')) or (table_name='measurement_units' and column_name in ('code','dimension')))) as columns, (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'schema',n.nspname,'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'config',p.proconfig)) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where (n.nspname||'.'||p.proname) in ('public.takeoff_item_hypothesis_cause','public.exclude_new_takeoff_hypothesis','private.takeoff_unit_dimension','private.assert_takeoff_single_quantity_source','private.normalize_unit','private.unit_token')) as functions, (select count(*) from pg_trigger where tgrelid='public.takeoff_items'::regclass and tgname='exclude_new_takeoff_hypothesis') as new_trigger_count;
queries.beforeCounts:
select count(*) as lignes,
       count(*) filter (where not is_excluded) as presele,
       count(*) filter (where not is_excluded and quantity_entry_category is null
         and (metadata ->> 'quantity_nature' = 'estimated'
           or jsonb_typeof(metadata #> '{rule_inputs,non_observable}') = 'string')) as hypotheses_presele
from public.takeoff_items item
join public.takeoff_jobs job on job.id = item.job_id
where job.status <> 'applied';

storedStatementVerification.queryTemplate: select clock_timestamp() as observed_at, version, name, cardinality(statements) as statements, octet_length(array_to_string(statements, '')) as bytes, encode(sha256(convert_to(array_to_string(statements, ''), 'UTF8')), 'hex') as sha256, cardinality(statements)=1 and statements[1]=$ti682_exact$<EXACT_SOURCE_FILE_CONTENT>$ti682_exact$ as stored_statement_equals_full_file from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where name='takeoff_hypothesis_preselection';
storedStatementVerification.substitution: <EXACT_SOURCE_FILE_CONTENT> was replaced with the full exact sourceCommit:path blob, including its final newline, before executing the read-only query.

queries.functions: select n.nspname as schema, p.proname, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as identity_arguments, p.prosecdef, p.proconfig, pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) as owner, p.provolatile, encode(sha256(convert_to(p.prosrc, 'UTF8')), 'hex') as body_sha256, exists(select 1 from aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a where a.grantee=0 and a.privilege_type='EXECUTE') as execute_public, has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE') as execute_anon, has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE') as execute_authenticated, has_function_privilege('service_role',p.oid,'EXECUTE') as execute_service_role from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where (n.nspname,p.proname) in (('public','takeoff_item_hypothesis_cause'),('public','exclude_new_takeoff_hypothesis'),('private','takeoff_unit_dimension'),('private','assert_takeoff_single_quantity_source')) order by n.nspname,p.proname;
queries.trigger: select tgname, tgenabled, tgtype, pg_get_triggerdef(oid) as definition from pg_trigger where tgrelid='public.takeoff_items'::regclass and tgname='exclude_new_takeoff_hypothesis';
